_about: Per-region open-water correction factors from stratified blind point validation (80 points/tile, hidden answer keys, Horvitz-Thompson estimation). 'raw' detections are meltwater-affected area (open water + slush + lidded lakes); multiply by open_water_factor for strict same-day open water. Regimes and provenance in output/shelf_val/<tile>/.

george_vi.note: false positives offset by missed margin water; HT-corrected 157+/-37 km2 vs 127 detected -> raw is unbiased-to-conservative

LarsenC.note: recall 1.0 means no missed-water offset; non-water detections are predominantly slush

Amery.note: pale-cyan lids ARE stored meltwater (counted by published Amery inventories); raw = meltwater-affected area remains the hydrofracture-relevant quantity

_unvalidated_default.note: shelves without per-region blind validation carry no correction; treat raw values as meltwater-affected area with regime unknown

LarsenB.regime: slush-dominated embayment (east Peninsula; strongest slush fraction validated)
LarsenB.note: recall 1.0, no missed-water offset; the headline 13.1% ponded fraction (2024-25) corrects to ~4.6% strict open water - comparable to George VI's record-year 5.8%, and remarkable for a collapse remnant
